question2.title: How can I be sure about the door quality?
question2.body: Check the warranty, certifications, and the manufacturer’s experience. You can also review portfolios and feedback from previous customers.

question3.title: What is the delivery time for the doors?
question3.body: Delivery time depends on the product type and level of customization, but it is usually between 7 and 20 business days.

about.heading: About GEZE
about.paragraph1: The GEZE family business began its operations in 1863. Over the past 160 years, the company has proven the quality of its products and services worldwide by using innovative technologies in automatic doors, windows, and smart building solutions, becoming a well-known global brand.
about.paragraph2: More than 3,000 employees work at GEZE branches around the world. The company has local offices in 37 countries and serves customers globally. All GEZE products are manufactured in accordance with international standards and hold recognized global certifications.

collaboration.text: PersiaDoor Automatic Doors maintains consistent quality in its products and services while remaining curious and active toward new markets and developments. Our goal is to become a leading brand in the automatic door industry and, by continuously innovating, contribute to improving safety and quality of life in our built environment.

hero.title: Hospitals
hero.text: With a deep understanding of hospital environments and their specific needs, PersiaDoor designs and supplies hospital doors that meet the highest hygiene standards and modern technologies. These doors provide easy, unobstructed access while minimizing touch points and enabling quick cleaning to support infection control. They also open wide enough for hospital beds and, when closed, help reduce unwanted air flow between zones.

howSection.title: How automatic doors help your healthcare facility

hygiene.title: Hygiene and safety
hygiene.text: Hospital automatic doors reduce touch points and remove the need for handles, helping to lower the risk of spreading infections. Their easy-to-clean surfaces support strict hygiene protocols in critical areas.

easyAccess.title: Easy circulation and time saving
easyAccess.text: Automatic doors allow staff and patients to enter and exit hands-free, without stopping. This is especially important in emergency situations and when moving beds or equipment.

accessControl.title: Access control
accessControl.text: These doors can be integrated with access control systems to monitor and restrict entry to sensitive hospital areas such as ICUs, operating theatres and isolation wards.

fireSafety.title: Security and fire safety
fireSafety.text: Fire-rated doors resist flames, limit the spread of smoke and toxic gases and still allow quick opening in emergencies, helping to protect the health and safety of occupants during fires.

installWarranty.title: Installation and warranty
installWarranty.text: PersiaDoor products are offered with a one-year free warranty for various industries. This warranty includes service, repair and parts replacement and, with a new contract, can be extended up to 5 years. All installation steps are performed by experienced technicians, coordinated and completed in the shortest possible time across Iran.

serviceRepair.title: Service and repair
serviceRepair.text: Periodic and on-demand service for all types of automatic doors and windows is provided under contract throughout Iran. Our service unit guarantees the quality of services and replacement parts, minimizing customers’ concerns. The goal of Persia Service is to repair and maintain components rather than simply replacing them. Our experienced technicians are available 24/7 all week long.
